summary: Independent frontend verification of QA-board fix batch on DynoPay preview. All 8 items PASS. Special attention to #15 LOGGED-IN dashboard route: successfully verified after mocking /api/* to prevent axios 401 interceptor from clearing the fake token on homepage load. Without network mocking, the homepage triggers an auth check with the fake JWT, receives 401 from backend, and force-redirects to /auth/login BEFORE the user can click the CTA. With API responses stubbed 200, the CTA correctly reads localStorage.token and router.push('/dashboard'). Please note this caveat.
